lines.text: Each logo is an ordinary flow image. It must occupy its own vertical band, keep its aspect ratio, and align
against the same text column in W ord, PDF, and PNG. No text wrapping or floating placement is
LEFT — the next logo begins at the left edge of the text column.
LEFT END — this full-width line begins below the complete logo.
CENTER — the next logo is centred within the text column.
CENTER END — this full-width line begins below the complete logo.
RIGHT — the next logo ends at the right edge of the text column.
RIGHT END — this full-width line begins below the complete logo.
PASS: all three logos retain the same size and ratio, use the requested left, centre, and right positions,
and leave following text at full width.
